summary: Clean implementation with no security, correctness, robustness, or design issues. The change replaces aggregate container/agent counts with per-agent role+status symbols in the DAG visualization box, introduces a shared _get_agent_status_symbol helper that maps all 4 AgentExecutionStatus values with a safe fallback, and updates generate_status_report to return structured agent detail lists instead of integer counts. The sorting lambda uses role_order.index() which is safe given Pydantic validation on AgentRole. Line-wrapping logic for 4+ agents is correct. Empty-list falsy check prevents rendering agent lines for phases without agents. The generate_status_report agents field type change from int to list[dict] is a breaking API change but is the intended behavior per issue requirements. All 35 tests pass including 6 new tests covering per-agent display, mixed statuses, no-agents, and ASCII mode.
